title: The Terminal ATC Training Guide: Insights and Strategies from a Veteran ATC Instructor
description: Air traffic controllers face constant judgment and critique. You’re expected to meet the demand of airport traffic and bear the ultimate responsibility of coordinating time and space. Are you prepared? Do you have all the tools you need to succeed? In The Terminal ATC Training Guide , Randolph Arslanian provides never-before-shared insight for handling any situation in air traffic control. A highly decorated air traffic controller with expertise in the most difficult airport operations, Randolph shares the strategies he’s used throughout his career, along with the training techniques gleaned from his experience. For beginners to certified controllers, you’ll gain a deep understanding of air traffic control, the flexibility to handle the rare or unusual, and the ability to train those who follow in your footsteps.
